title: Northwind IT Infrastructure Services - Company Profile
text: Northwind IT Infrastructure Services Pvt. Ltd. was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2012 under the Indian Companies Act, 1956, and has owned and operated its own 24x7 Network Operations Centre in Bengaluru since March 2014. As of 31 January 2024 it had 640 employees on payroll and a standalone (individual company) turnover of Rs 31.4 Cr in FY 2020-21, Rs 36.8 Cr in FY 2021-22 and Rs 42.5 Cr in FY 2022-23, an average of Rs 36.9 Cr.

title: Audited Financial Summary FY 2020-21 to FY 2022-23
text: Audited statements certified by the statutory auditor show net profit after tax of Rs 2.1 Cr (FY 2020-21), Rs 2.9 Cr (FY 2021-22) and Rs 3.6 Cr (FY 2022-23). Figures are for Northwind as an individual company and exclude any group or subsidiary entity.

title: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System Certificate
text: Northwind holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for managed network services and NOC operations at its Bengaluru facility, issued on 15 January 2024 after a recertification audit. The certificate is valid for three years.

title: ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 IT Service Management Certificate
text: Northwind's IT service management system covering incident, change, problem and service level management for remote and onsite NOC services is certified to ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018. The certificate was issued on 5 September 2024 following a surveillance-to-recertification audit.

title: ISO/IEC 27001:2013 Certificate - 24x7 NOC, Bengaluru
text: Northwind's Information Security Management System for its 24x7 Network Operations Centre in Bengaluru was certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2013 on 1 November 2022. The certificate scope covers NOC monitoring, network device management and log management.

title: ISO 22301:2019 Business Continuity Management Certificate
text: Northwind's business continuity management system for NOC service delivery, including a secondary monitoring site in Mysuru, has been certified to ISO 22301:2019 since 12 March 2024. Annual BCP drills achieved monitoring switchover within 45 minutes in 2024.

title: Udyam (MSME) Registration Certificate
text: Northwind is registered as a Small Enterprise under the MSME Udyam registration scheme for IT network services, with registration dated 18 July 2021. The classification was reconfirmed on the Udyam portal for FY 2023-24.

title: Onsite NOC Managed Services - Private Sector Bank
text: From April 2019 to March 2024 Northwind provided onsite NOC services from Client-A's premises, managing and monitoring 1,150 routers and switches across 310 branches and 640 links (MPLS, extranet and WiMAX/ISDN backup) from four service providers. Monthly uptime reports for FY 2022-23 recorded 99.6% for dual-link offices and 98.4% for single-link offices.

title: Onsite NOC and WAN Link Management - General Insurer
text: Since July 2020 Northwind has supported Client-B with an onsite NOC covering 960 network devices, installation and configuration of L2/L3 devices at 240 branches, and management of 520 branch and backup links across three providers. The purchase order runs to June 2025.

title: Master Services Agreement - Client-C (Confidential)
text: Under a January 2021 master services agreement Northwind operates an onsite NOC at Client-C's head office, managing 1,420 remote network devices, WAN and L2/L3 devices at 415 branches and 790 links from five service providers, with the term running to December 2025. The agreement contains a confidentiality clause that prohibits disclosure of the client's identity, contract value or scope to any third party without written consent.

title: Network Monitoring and Branch Support - Co-operative Bank
text: Between May 2021 and April 2023 Northwind supported Client-D's network team with onsite monitoring of 880 network devices, configuration support at 205 branches and coordination of 470 links. The engagement was completed with a completion certificate issued in May 2023.

title: MPLS and WiMAX Backup Link Coordination - Securities Firm
text: From August 2022 Northwind provided link management for Client-E covering 260 MPLS primary and WiMAX/broadband backup links, including feasibility checks, order follow-up and escalation with service providers. Average link restoration time fell from 19 hours to 7 hours within the first year.

title: SD-WAN Migration Support - Retail Lender
text: In 2023 Northwind supported Client-F in migrating 180 branches from legacy MPLS routers to SD-WAN edge devices in four phases, with no branch down for more than 4 business hours during cut-over. The project included updated network diagrams and version-controlled configuration templates.

title: Data Centre Structured Cabling - Payments Company
text: During 2022 Northwind provided structured cabling services at Client-G's data centre, laying and testing 1,800 Cat6A copper and OM4/single-mode fibre ports with LC/SC terminations. As-built drawings and test results were handed over for all racks and hub rooms.

title: Network Access Control Rollout - Mutual Fund Registrar
text: In 2023 Northwind supported Client-H's rollout of 802.1X network access control across 3,200 endpoints at 62 offices. Change requests were raised and approved through Client-H's change advisory board before each phase.

title: VA/PT Remediation Closure - Housing Finance Company
text: In 2022 Northwind's NOC team helped Client-I close 96% of high and medium vulnerabilities from quarterly VA/PT exercises on routers, switches and firewalls within 30 days, coordinating firmware fixes with OEMs. Re-validation scans were run after each fix and the reports were shared with the client's auditors.

title: NMS Tool Migration to Cloud-Based Monitoring - NBFC
text: In 2021 Northwind provided migration support for Client-J moving 1,050 monitored devices from an on-premise NMS to a cloud-based NMS/EMS platform with SIEM log forwarding. Device onboarding was completed in 11 weeks with dashboards for incident, change and SLA management.

title: IPv4 to IPv6 Dual-Stack Enablement - Stock Broking Firm
text: In 2023 Northwind supported Client-K in enabling IPv6 dual-stack on 140 core and distribution devices and its internet edge. The work followed an approved test plan with proof-of-concept testing in a lab before production changes.

title: Telecom Billing Reconciliation and Service Closure - Insurance Broker
text: From 2020 to 2023 Northwind managed monthly and quarterly telecom billing for Client-L's 410 links, using a maker-checker review that identified Rs 18 lakh in over-billing for recovery. On link closures the team collected site equipment and updated the central asset register.

title: Branch Preventive Maintenance Programme - Regional Bank
text: During 2022-2023 Northwind conducted half-yearly preventive maintenance and quarterly visits at 150 branches of Client-M, with branch-manager-signed feedback reports filed for each visit. Findings were closed within 7 days in 94% of cases.

title: Certified Staff on Payroll - Summary
text: As of 31 January 2024 Northwind's payroll included 34 CCNA, 7 CCNP, 3 CCIE and 4 PMP certified employees, each with at least 2 years' relevant experience after certification. Of these, 26 CCNA, 5 CCNP, 3 CCIE and 3 PMP holders had at least 1 year of experience with Northwind.

title: Profile - Project Manager cum L3 Engineer (Emp. NW-1043)
text: B.E. (Electronics) engineer, CCNP Enterprise certified in 2016, with 8 years' post-CCNP experience and PMP certification from 2019. Has supported WLAN, voice and video conferencing networks on multi-OEM routers, switches and wireless controllers and served as onsite project manager for Client-A's NOC.

title: Profile - Core Network Engineer (Emp. NW-1187)
text: B.Tech engineer, CCNP Enterprise certified in 2019, with 4.5 years' post-CCNP experience managing MPLS and SD-WAN topologies, policy-based routing, ACLs and IP SLA. Supported NAC rollout and routing changes for Client-H in 2023.

title: Profile - Project Manager, NMS (Emp. NW-0921)
text: B.E. engineer with CCNA, with 6 years in NMS management roles covering device onboarding, alert tuning and SLA reporting. Led the operations side of the Client-J NMS migration in 2021.

title: Profile - NMS Engineer (Emp. NW-1302)
text: Diploma engineer with CCNA certified in 2020, with 3.5 years' experience monitoring WAN links and routers in a 24x7 NOC. Has handled link-down escalations with public-sector and private telecom service providers for Client-E.

title: Profile - Data Centre Cabling Technician (Emp. NW-0778)
text: Technical diploma holder with 7 years' experience in data centre structured cabling design, installation and maintenance, including Cat6A and fibre LIU testing. Provided onsite cabling for Client-G's data centre in 2022.

title: NOC Capability - Monitoring, Logging and Archival
text: Northwind's NOC runs 24x7x365 with NMS/EMS monitoring, retains device syslogs online for 90 days with SIEM forwarding, and archives older logs in compressed, hash-verified (tamper-evident) form for 3 years. Incident, change and problem processes follow ITIL v4, with RCA reports for critical incidents targeted within 48 hours.

title: Personnel Security and Staffing Policy
text: All Northwind NOC and onsite staff are on company payroll (no outsourced or sub-contracted staff), complete third-party background verification before deployment, and sign confidentiality and non-disclosure undertakings. Planned leave over 2 days is covered by a trained shadow resource, and staff transfers require 30 days' notice to the client.

title: Declaration - Blacklisting and Penalty History
text: Northwind has not been blacklisted by any government body, PSU, bank or other entity between February 2021 and January 2024. No client imposed penalties amounting to 10% or more of annual contract value in the same period.

title: Transition and Due Diligence Methodology
text: Northwind's transition method runs in four phases (initiation, planning, execution and closure) and has been used on 9 NOC takeovers since 2018, with steady-state operations reached in a median of 26 days. Each phase ends with a client sign-off on SOPs, escalation matrices and run-books.
